### Added

- *(model-serving)* The cache outlives a pool teardown — the serving namespace is kept while the cache is on, the claim gets a fast gp3 StorageClass of its own by default, and vLLM's compile cache lives on the claim (VLLM_CACHE_ROOT) in [#538](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/538) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/compare/v4.30.3...v4.31.0
